原文: 如果我们只追求短期增长而忽视基础研究，下一次技术范式转移到来时就可能失去主动权。
翻译: If we pursue short-term growth at the expense of fundamental research, we may lose the initiative when the next technological paradigm shifts.

原文: 这个系统在测试环境里表现稳定，但一旦并发量接近峰值，隐藏在缓存一致性里的问题就会集中爆发。
翻译: The system performs stably in the testing environment, but once the concurrency approaches its peak, issues hidden within cache consistency emerge intensively.

原文: 团队并不是缺少聪明人，而是缺少把复杂问题拆解为可验证假设的共同方法。
翻译: The team isn’t short of smart people; it lacks a common approach to breaking down complex problems into testable hypotheses.

原文: 当你把所有功能都堆到首页时，用户看似拥有更多选择，实际上更难完成最核心的任务。
翻译: When all features are crammed onto the homepage, users may seem to have more options, but in reality, it becomes harder for them to complete their most essential tasks.

原文: 新员工在前三个月形成的工作习惯，往往比入职培训手册里的任何口号都更能决定团队文化。
翻译: The work habits formed by new employees in their first three months often determine team culture more than any slogans in the onboarding training manual.

原文: 那家小店之所以总有人排队，不是因为装修多高级，而是老板记得常客不吃香菜这种细节。
翻译: The reason there’s always a line at that small shop isn’t its fancy decor, but rather the owner’s attention to details like remembering that regular customers don’t eat cilantro.

原文: 与其在社交媒体上反复证明自己，不如把时间留给真正会在困难时站在你身边的人。
翻译: Instead of constantly proving yourself on social media, spend your time with those who will truly be there for you in tough times.

原文: 孩子问的问题有时看似天真，却会逼着成年人重新审视那些被默认正确的答案。
翻译: The questions children ask may seem naive at first, but they force adults to reconsider those answers that were once taken for granted as correct.

原文: 我们原本以为只是换了一个沟通工具，后来才发现真正改变的是协作节奏和责任边界。
翻译: We initially thought it was just a change in communication tools, but later realized that what truly changed were the pace of collaboration and the boundaries of responsibility.

原文: 预算削减之后，最先被取消的常常是长期项目，而这些项目恰恰决定了三年后的竞争力。
翻译: After budget cuts, long-term projects are often the first to be eliminated—projects that precisely determine competitiveness in three years.

原文: 虽然实验结果尚未达到统计显著性，但多个独立样本呈现出同方向变化，这值得继续追踪。
翻译: Although the experimental results have not yet reached statistical significance, multiple independent samples show changes in the same direction, which warrants further investigation.

原文: 研究人员提醒公众，相关性并不等于因果性，尤其在样本量有限时更容易产生误判。
翻译: Researchers warn the public that correlation does not equal causation, and misjudgments are more likely to occur, especially with limited sample sizes.

原文: 这项疗法在早期试验中显示出希望，不过其长期副作用仍需通过更大规模随访来确认。
翻译: This therapy has shown promise in early trials, but its long-term side effects still need to be confirmed through larger-scale follow-up studies.

原文: 当观测仪器的分辨率提升一个数量级，我们对同一现象的解释框架也随之被迫更新。
翻译: When the resolution of observational instruments improves by an order of magnitude, our framework for explaining the same phenomenon is also forced to be updated.

原文: 气候模型给出的不是唯一结论，而是一组概率分布，政策制定必须在不确定性中做决策。
翻译: Climate models do not provide a single conclusion but rather a set of probability distributions, requiring policymakers to make decisions amid uncertainty.

原文: 小说没有直接写战争，却通过一盏反复熄灭的煤油灯让读者感到时代的阴影。
翻译: The novel does not directly depict war, but through an oil lamp that keeps going out, it allows readers to sense the shadows of the era.

原文: 她的诗句看似平静，停顿与留白却像暗流一样推动情感在读者心里缓慢堆积。
翻译: Her verses appear calm, yet their pauses and silences act like hidden currents, slowly building emotions in the reader’s heart.

原文: 导演刻意省略高潮场面，把叙事重心放在失败之后的沉默，这反而让结局更有力量。
翻译: The director deliberately omitted the climax, focusing instead on the silence that followed failure, which made the ending even more powerful.

原文: 译者若只追求字面对应，往往会牺牲原文的节奏和语气，从而错过真正的文学性。
翻译: If a translator focuses solely on literal equivalence, they often sacrifice the rhythm and tone of the original text, thereby missing its true literary quality.

原文: 这篇散文最难翻译的不是典故，而是那种若即若离的自嘲口吻。
翻译: The most challenging part of translating this essay is not the allusions, but that tone of self-mockery that remains just out of reach.

原文: 在多语言产品中，同一个按钮文案在不同文化里可能触发完全不同的心理预期。
翻译: In multilingual products, the same button text can evoke entirely different psychological expectations across different cultures.

原文: 我们花了两周优化启动速度，结果用户满意度提升的关键却是首次使用时的引导文案。
翻译: We spent two weeks optimizing startup speed, yet the key to improving user satisfaction turned out to be the onboarding message during the first use.

原文: 即使结论正确，若推理过程无法复现，也很难说服同行接受这项研究。
翻译: Even if the conclusion is correct, it will be difficult to convince peers to accept the research if the reasoning process cannot be replicated.

原文: 一项技术是否先进，不只看模型参数规模，还要看它在真实场景中的可维护性与能耗。
翻译: The advancement of a technology cannot be judged solely by the size of its model parameters; it also depends on its maintainability and energy consumption in real-world scenarios.

原文: 当实验失败成为可公开讨论的常态，团队学习速度通常会比只展示成功案例时更快。
翻译: When experimental failures become part of normal public discussion, teams typically learn faster than when only successful cases are presented.

原文: 这次暴雨并没有刷新历史极值，却因排水系统老化让一座城市在两小时内陷入瘫痪。
翻译: Although this torrential rain did not set a new historical record, an aging drainage system left a city paralyzed within two hours.

原文: 医生解释方案时用了大量术语，病人点头表示理解，但回家后依然不知道该如何用药。
翻译: The doctor used many medical terms when explaining the treatment plan. The patient nodded to show they understood, but still didn’t know how to take the medication when they got home.

原文: 他在演讲里引用了许多数据，然而最打动听众的却是那个关于母亲的简短故事。
翻译: He cited many statistics in his speech, yet what truly moved the audience was the brief story about his mother.

原文: 如果把所有风险都转移给供应商，看起来成本下降了，实际上只是把不确定性延后结算。
翻译: If all risks are shifted to the supplier, it may seem like costs have decreased, but in reality, it merely delays the settlement of uncertainties.

原文: 我们可以接受进度放缓，但不能接受在需求不清楚时仓促上线再让用户买单。
翻译: We can accept a slower pace of progress, but we cannot tolerate launching something hastily when requirements are unclear and then having users bear the consequences.

原文: 这篇论文方法并不复杂，真正难得的是作者把失败实验也系统地写进了附录。
翻译: The methodology of this paper is not complicated; what’s truly remarkable is that the author systematically included failed experiments in the appendix as well.

原文: 你越想把每句话都说得无懈可击，越容易失去对话中最珍贵的真实感。
翻译: The more you try to make every sentence perfect, the easier it is to lose the precious authenticity in a conversation.

原文: 她离开故乡多年后才明白，记忆之所以温柔，并不是因为过去没有裂缝。
翻译: It was only years after leaving her hometown that she realized why memories remain tender—not because the past is free of cracks.

原文: 当机器能够生成看似完美的文本时，人类写作者更需要证明自己为何值得被阅读。
翻译: When machines can produce seemingly perfect text, human writers need to prove even more why they deserve to be read.

原文: 这场争论表面上关于术语定义，深层上却是两种价值排序的冲突。
翻译: On the surface, this debate is about terminology definitions, but at its core it reflects a conflict between two different value systems.

原文: 山重水复疑无路，柳暗花明又一村。
翻译: After many twists and turns through mountains and rivers, I thought there was no way forward; yet suddenly, among the willows and blossoms, another village appeared.

原文: 纸上得来终觉浅，绝知此事要躬行。
翻译: What is learned from books seems shallow at first; true understanding comes only through hands-on experience.

原文: 既要仰望星空，也要脚踏实地。
翻译: One must look up at the stars while keeping feet on the ground.

原文: 授人以鱼不如授人以渔。
翻译: Giving a man a fish is not as good as teaching him how to fish.

原文: 千里之行，始于足下。
翻译: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.

原文: 这座城市醒得很早，却很少有人真正停下来吃一顿慢早餐。
翻译: The city wakes up early, yet few people actually take the time to enjoy a leisurely breakfast.

原文: 她说“没关系”的时候，语气里的颤抖比眼泪更诚实。
翻译: When she said “It’s okay,” the tremor in her voice was more honest than tears.

原文: 他把失败称作弯路，其实那是通往成熟的必经路标。
翻译: He calls failure a detour, but in truth it is an essential milestone on the path to maturity.

原文: 风从旧巷穿过，把童年的叫卖声吹得忽远忽近。
翻译: The wind blew through the old alleys, carrying the sounds of childhood vendors in and out of reach.

原文: 灯火可亲，柴米有味，便是寻常日子的英雄主义。
翻译: Warm lights and nourishing food—these are the acts of heroism in ordinary days.

原文: 所谓天赋，不过是把重复做到别人不愿坚持的程度。
翻译: What’s called talent is simply doing something repeatedly to the extent that others refuse to persist.

原文: 你可以暂时看不到答案，但不要因此停止提问。
翻译: You might not be able to see the answer right away, but don’t stop asking questions because of that.

原文: 一个人真正的体面，不在顺境里的风光，而在失意时仍不苛责他人。
翻译: True dignity lies not in glory in good times, but in not blaming others even in adversity.

原文: 我们都在学着告别，只是有人把转身写成了诗。
翻译: We’re all learning to say goodbye; some just turn that farewell into poetry.

原文: 雨停了，树叶还在滴水，像一句话说完后仍有回响。
翻译: The rain has stopped, but the leaves still drip, like echoes lingering after a sentence is spoken.

原文: 她并非无所畏惧，只是决定先迈出那一步再与恐惧和解。
翻译: She isn’t fearless—she simply decided to take that first step before reconciling with her fears.

原文: 这个世界奖励速度，但深刻往往来自缓慢。
翻译: The world rewards speed, but depth often comes from slowness.

原文: 若你长期凝视深渊，也别忘了回头看看身后的灯。
翻译: If you gaze into the abyss for too long, don’t forget to look back at the light behind you.

原文: 说理可以赢得辩论，共情才能赢得人心。
翻译: Reason can win debates, but empathy wins hearts.

原文: 愿你历尽千帆，归来仍有少年般的好奇。
翻译: May you weather countless storms and return with the curiosity of a young mind.

原文: 请把会议纪要在今晚六点前发我，我需要据此更新明天的客户提案。
翻译: Please send me the meeting minutes by 6 p.m. tonight; I need them to update tomorrow’s client proposal.

原文: 麻烦你到楼下代收一下快递，我现在在视频会议里暂时走不开。
翻译: Could you please pick up the delivery downstairs for me? I’m in a video conference right now and can’t leave for a while.

原文: 这道菜有点辣，能帮我换成不放辣椒的版本吗？
翻译: This dish is a bit spicy. Could you help me get it without chili?

原文: 我临时有事可能会晚到十分钟，你们先开始不用等我。
翻译: I might be 10 minutes late due to an unexpected matter. You can start without waiting for me.

原文: 如果你周末有空，我们可以一起把旧衣服整理出来捐掉。
翻译: If you’re free over the weekend, we can go together and sort through old clothes to donate them.

原文: 这家医院网上预约很快就满号，建议你提前一周设置提醒。
翻译: Appointments at this hospital fill up quickly online, so I recommend setting a reminder a week in advance.

原文: 我已经把修改意见标在文档批注里，辛苦你看完后统一回复。
翻译: I’ve marked the suggestions for revision in the document comments. Please take the time to review them and reply together.

原文: 由于天气原因，原定于今晚的户外活动将改到室内进行。
翻译: Due to weather conditions, the outdoor event originally scheduled for tonight will be moved indoors.

原文: 抱歉刚才语气有点急，我的本意是想尽快把问题解决掉。
翻译: I’m sorry for my hasty tone earlier; I just wanted to resolve the issue as quickly as possible.

原文: 这份合同的付款条款我还需要和法务再确认一次。
翻译: I need to check the payment terms of this contract with the legal team again.

原文: 为了减少误解，我们把关键决策都记录在共享文档中。
翻译: To avoid misunderstandings, we document all key decisions in a shared document.

原文: 她看起来很平静，但其实在为即将到来的答辩做最后冲刺。
翻译: She appears calm, but in reality she’s putting in final efforts for her upcoming defense.

原文: 这款应用上手门槛不高，真正难的是持续使用形成习惯。
翻译: This app isn’t difficult to get started with; the real challenge is maintaining consistent use to build a habit.

原文: 社区图书馆虽然不大，却总能在雨天给人一种被收留的安全感。
翻译: Though small, the community library always offers a sense of safety and shelter on rainy days.

原文: 他并不擅长夸夸其谈，却总能在关键时刻给出可执行的方案。
翻译: He isn’t good at empty rhetoric, but he always comes up with actionable solutions at critical moments.

原文: 如果实验数据今晚还没跑完，我们就把发布计划顺延到下周一。
翻译: If the experimental data isn’t ready by tonight, we’ll postpone the release to next Monday.

原文: 你先别急着下结论，等把原始样本再核对一遍。
翻译: Don’t rush to draw conclusions; double-check the original sample first.

原文: 奶奶常说，饭桌上的沉默比争吵更让人心慌。
翻译: Grandma used to say that silence at the dinner table is more unsettling than arguments.

原文: 当我们终于谈到彼此真正担心的事情时，谈判才算正式开始。
翻译: Only when we finally discuss what each of us is truly concerned about does the negotiation truly begin.

原文: 请在提交前检查单位和小数点，很多低级错误都出在这里。
翻译: Please check the units and decimal points before submitting, as many basic errors occur here.

原文: Although the prototype looked impressive in demos, it failed in production because no one had tested how it behaved under unstable network conditions.
翻译: 尽管在演示中该原型看起来相当出色，但由于没人测试过它在不稳定网络环境下的表现，最终在实际应用中失败了。

原文: The team agreed to postpone the release, not because the core feature was unfinished, but because the migration plan could have broken existing customer workflows.
翻译: 团队决定推迟发布，不是因为核心功能尚未完成，而是因为迁移方案可能会扰乱现有客户的工作流程。

原文: If you optimize only for click-through rate, you may win short-term attention while quietly eroding long-term user trust.
翻译: 如果只追求点击率，虽然能暂时吸引注意力，却会悄悄损害用户的长期信任。

原文: What appears to be a simple bug is often the visible symptom of a deeper mismatch between product assumptions and real user behavior.
翻译: 看似简单的故障，往往其实是产品预期与实际用户行为之间存在更深层差异的体现。

原文: By the time we realized the documentation was outdated, three new hires had already learned the wrong deployment process.
翻译: 等到我们发现文档已经过时时，已有三名新员工学会了错误的部署流程。

原文: She speaks softly, yet every sentence lands with the precision of someone who has revised her thoughts for years.
翻译: 她说话轻声细语，但每一句话都显得极为精准，仿佛经过多年深思熟虑后才说出口。

原文: We kept adding notifications to improve engagement, then discovered that constant interruption was exactly why users were leaving.
翻译: 我们不断添加通知以提高用户参与度，结果却发现正是这些频繁的干扰导致了用户流失。

原文: The child did not ask for a perfect answer; he asked a question that adults were afraid to sit with.
翻译: 那孩子并非在寻求完美的答案，他只是提出了一个连成年人都害怕正视的问题。

原文: Even after the storm passed, the town remained without power, revealing how fragile the infrastructure had become.
翻译: 即便风暴过后，小镇仍处于断电状态，这凸显出其基础设施已变得极为脆弱。

原文: The restaurant is famous not for expensive ingredients, but for the patience with which it prepares ordinary food.
翻译: 这家餐厅出名并非因为使用了昂贵的食材，而是因为它以极大的耐心烹制普通的食物。

原文: The study does not prove causation, but the repeated pattern across independent datasets deserves serious attention.
翻译: 这项研究并未证明因果关系，但不同独立数据集中反复出现的这种模式值得认真关注。

原文: Once the telescope captured higher-resolution images, several textbook explanations had to be rewritten.
翻译: 当望远镜拍出更高分辨率的图像后，几本教科书中的相关解释不得不被重新撰写。

原文: The treatment showed promise in early trials, yet researchers warned that rare side effects might appear only in long-term follow-up.
翻译: 早期试验显示该疗法颇具前景，但研究人员警告称，罕见的副作用可能仅在长期随访中才会出现。

原文: Policy makers asked for certainty, but climate scientists could only provide scenarios with different probabilities and trade-offs.
翻译: 决策者要求确定性，但气候科学家只能提供具有不同概率与权衡的情景。

原文: A single outlier can distort the average, which is why robust statistics matter when decisions affect millions of people.
翻译: 一个异常值就足以扭曲平均值，正因如此，在涉及数百万人利益的决策中，稳健的统计方法显得尤为重要。

原文: The novel never names the war directly, but its silence is filled with the sounds of evacuation and absence.
翻译: 这部小说从未直接提及那场战争，但其沉默之中却充满了疏散与离别之声。

原文: Her poems seem plain at first glance, until you notice how every pause redirects the emotional rhythm.
翻译: 她的诗乍看之下似乎平淡无奇，直到你注意到每一次停顿都在如何引导情感的节奏。

原文: The translator preserved the literal meaning, but the dialogue lost the irony that made the original unforgettable.
翻译: 译者虽然保留了原文的字面意思，却失去了让原作令人难忘的讽刺意味。

原文: The film avoids a triumphant ending, choosing instead to linger on the quiet cost of survival.
翻译: 这部电影没有选择令人欣慰的结局，而是着重展现了生存背后那些默默承受的代价。

原文: He left his hometown decades ago, only to realize that memory edits the past as carefully as a novelist edits a draft.
翻译: 他数十年前离开了故乡，后来才意识到，记忆会像小说家修改草稿一样精心地重塑过去。

原文: We spent months refining the algorithm, and then learned that clearer onboarding text improved outcomes more than any model tweak.
翻译: 我们花了数月时间优化算法，后来发现更清晰的引导文本比任何模型调整都能更好地提升效果。

原文: A tool is not truly advanced if only experts can maintain it after the first wave of enthusiasm fades.
翻译: 如果在一阵热情消退后只有专家才能维护它，那么这样的工具就算不上真正先进。

原文: The meeting sounded productive, yet no one had defined who would own the next decision by Friday.
翻译: 会议似乎很有成效，但却没有人明确谁将在周五之前负责做出下一步决策。

原文: Every failed experiment was logged in detail, allowing the team to eliminate dead ends faster than their competitors.
翻译: 每次失败的实验都会被详细记录下来，这使该团队能够比竞争对手更快地排除无效路径。

原文: The merger looked efficient on paper, but it erased local knowledge that had quietly sustained service quality.
翻译: 从表面上看，这次合并效率很高，但却抹去了那些默默维持服务质量的本地经验。

原文: Because the dataset was imbalanced, the model performed well overall while consistently failing on minority cases.
翻译: 由于数据集存在不平衡现象，模型整体表现尚可，但在处理少数类样本时却一直表现不佳。

原文: The doctor used technical terms accurately, but the patient still went home unsure about when to take the medication.
翻译: 医生准确使用了专业术语，但患者回家后仍不确定该在何时服药。

原文: He cited dozens of statistics, but the audience remembered the story about his grandmother waiting in a clinic hallway.
翻译: 他列举了数十组数据，但听众记住的却是他祖母在诊所走廊里等候的那段故事。

原文: You can reduce visible cost by outsourcing risk, yet the uncertainty returns later as operational debt.
翻译: 通过将风险外包，你可以降低显性成本，但这些不确定性日后仍会以运营债务的形式重新出现。

原文: We can tolerate a slower roadmap, but not a launch that turns users into unpaid testers.
翻译: 我们可以接受节奏较慢的规划，但绝不能让用户沦为无偿测试员。

原文: What looked like disagreement over terminology was actually a conflict between two value systems.
翻译: 看似是术语上的分歧，实际上却是两种价值体系之间的冲突。

原文: As generative models become fluent, human writers must explain what depth, judgment, and accountability still mean.
翻译: 随着生成模型越来越熟练，人类作家仍需阐明深度、判断力与责任究竟意味着什么。

原文: The city did not break rainfall records that week, but aging drains were enough to flood entire neighborhoods.
翻译: 那周该市的降雨量并未打破纪录，但老化的排水系统已足以导致整个社区被淹。

原文: The committee requested a single answer, while the evidence pointed to several plausible explanations.
翻译: 委员会要求一个统一的答案，而证据却表明存在多种合理的解释。

原文: If we cannot reproduce the reasoning path, a correct conclusion is still a weak foundation for science.
翻译: 如果我们无法复现这一推理过程，那么正确的结论对科学而言依然只是薄弱的基础。

原文: Where there is a will, there is a way.
翻译: 有志者，事竟成。

原文: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
翻译: 千里之行，始于足下。

原文: Give a person a fish and you feed them for a day; teach them to fish and you feed them for a lifetime.
翻译: 授人以鱼，可养一日之口；授人以渔，则可养终身。

原文: The lights are warm, the rice is fragrant, and ordinary days are quietly heroic.
翻译: 灯光温暖，米饭香甜，平凡的日子里也藏着默默的英勇。

原文: She said "I'm fine," but her trembling voice told a different story.
翻译: 她说“我没事”，但颤抖的声音却透露出另一番情景。

原文: He called it a detour, but it was the road on which he learned how to grow up.
翻译: 他称那是一条绕路，但却是他学会成长的道路。

原文: The wind passed through the old alley, carrying street cries from a childhood that never fully left.
翻译: 风穿过那条老巷，带来了那些从未真正远离的童年记忆中的叫卖声。

原文: This world rewards speed, yet depth is often born in slowness.
翻译: 这个世界奖励速度，然而深度往往源于从容不迫。

原文: You may not see the answer yet, but do not stop asking better questions.
翻译: 你可能暂时还看不到答案，但请不要停止提出更好的问题。

原文: Reason can win an argument; empathy can win a heart.
翻译: 理性能赢得辩论，而同理心能赢得人心。

原文: Even after the rain stopped, drops kept falling from the leaves like an afterthought of the sky.
翻译: 雨停之后，树叶上仍不断有水滴落下，仿佛是天空余留的痕迹。

原文: Real dignity is not how brightly you shine in success, but how gently you treat others in defeat.
翻译: 真正的尊严不在于成功时多么光彩夺目，而在于失败时如何温柔对待他人。

原文: We are all learning to say goodbye, only some people turn that turning away into poetry.
翻译: 我们都在学习如何告别，只是有些人将这种转身化作诗篇。

原文: Courage is not the absence of fear, but the decision to move while fear is still present.
翻译: 勇气并非没有恐惧，而是在仍有恐惧时依然选择前行。

原文: He was not fearless; he simply took one step before negotiating with his fear.
翻译: 他并非无所畏惧，只是先迈出一步，再与恐惧作斗争。

原文: The city wakes early, but few people sit down long enough for a slow breakfast.
翻译: 这座城市很早就醒了，但很少有人有足够的时间坐下来慢慢享用早餐。

原文: Talent is often just disciplined repetition that others are unwilling to sustain.
翻译: 天赋往往只是他人不愿坚持的、有规律的重复罢了。

原文: May you cross many seas and still return with a beginner's curiosity.
翻译: 愿您跨越无数海洋，归来时仍怀有初学者般的探索之心。

原文: When words run out, silence continues the sentence.
翻译: 当言语耗尽时，沉默继续着这句话。

原文: The deepest conversations begin when both sides admit what they are truly afraid of.
翻译: 最深刻的对话，始于双方都坦诚自己真正害怕的事物。

原文: Please send me the meeting minutes by 6 p.m. so I can finalize tomorrow's client proposal.
翻译: 请在下午6点前将会议记录发给我，以便我完成明天的客户提案。

原文: Could you pick up my package downstairs? I'm stuck in a video call.
翻译: 能帮我去楼下取一下包裹吗？我正忙于视频通话，抽不出身。

原文: This dish is a bit too spicy for me; could you make a non-spicy version?
翻译: 这道菜对我来说有点太辣了，能做一份不辣的吗？

原文: I might be about ten minutes late because of an urgent issue, so please start without me.
翻译: 因为有个紧急情况，我可能会晚十分钟左右，麻烦你们先开始吧。

原文: If you're free this weekend, we can sort out old clothes and donate them together.
翻译: 如果你这个周末有空，我们可以一起整理旧衣服并捐赠出去。

原文: Appointments at this hospital fill up quickly online, so set a reminder at least a week in advance.
翻译: 这家医院的线上预约名额很快就会被抢满，建议至少提前一周设置提醒。

原文: I've left comments in the document; please review them and reply in one batch.
翻译: 我已在文档中留下了评论，请一并查看并回复。

原文: Due to weather conditions, tonight's outdoor event will be moved indoors.
翻译: 由于天气原因，今晚的户外活动将移至室内举行。

原文: Sorry if I sounded sharp earlier; I just wanted to resolve the issue quickly.
翻译: 如果我刚才的语气显得生硬，还请见谅；我只是想尽快解决这个问题。

原文: I still need to confirm the payment terms in this contract with our legal team.
翻译: 我还需要与我们的法务团队确认这份合同中的付款条款。

原文: To reduce misunderstandings, let's document all key decisions in a shared file.
翻译: 为避免误解，我们把所有关键决策记录在共享文件中吧。

原文: She looks calm, but she's sprinting toward the final stretch of her thesis defense.
翻译: 她看起来很平静，但实际上正在全速奔向论文答辩的最后阶段。

原文: This app is easy to start, but hard to stick with long enough to form a habit.
翻译: 这款应用很容易开始使用，但要坚持足够长的时间形成习惯却相当困难。

原文: The community library is small, yet on rainy days it feels like a shelter.
翻译: 社区图书馆虽然不大，但在雨天却宛如一处避风港。

原文: He is not a flashy speaker, but he delivers executable plans when it matters.
翻译: 他并非能言善辩之人，但在关键时刻总能提出可行的计划。

原文: If the experiment hasn't finished running tonight, we'll move the release to next Monday.
翻译: 如果今晚的实验尚未完成，我们将把发布时间推迟到下周一。

原文: Let's not jump to conclusions until we recheck the raw samples.
翻译: 在重新检查原始样本之前，我们先不要急于下结论。

原文: Grandma used to say that silence at the dinner table can be more unsettling than an argument.
翻译: 奶奶常说，餐桌上的一片沉默比争吵更令人不安。

原文: The negotiation only truly began when we spoke about what each side feared losing.
翻译: 直到我们开始讨论双方最担心失去的东西时，谈判才真正开始。

原文: Please verify units and decimal points before submission; many avoidable errors happen there.
翻译: 提交前请务必核对单位和小数点，很多本可避免的错误都是由此产生的。
